exposure: histologic diagnosis (squamous cell carcinoma, adenocarcinoma, adenosquamous carcinoma)
outcome: obstetrical outcomes (pregnancies, live births, prematurity rate)
cohort: The study included 132 women who underwent consecutive vaginal radical trachelectomies for early-stage cervical cancer in two major referral centers in the Netherlands.
finding: Nonsquamous cell histology and high-grade disease are associated with a significantly higher risk of recurrence after VRT, and pregnancies after VRT must be regarded as high-risk with a high prematurity rate.
